text:
maria: Quick sync — final cutover acceptance for Private v1. We need anchors for SLA, docs, oncall, monitoring, pricing freeze. Owners by EOD?

josh: SLA anchors: 99.9% uptime SLO for API, 95th p50 lat target 120ms for small payloads. Agree? need to surface these in the SLA doc.

anika: Docs: I'll own the customer-facing runbook + integration guide. Will have draft by tomorrow. Need final API examples and example configs from eng.

tom: Oncall: ops team needs an escalation ladder + runbook with mitigations for hot restarts and model fallback. I can draft playbook. @maria which shift coverage? :thinking:

maria: Coverage: start with PST day shift for 2w then 24/7 oncall if no major incidents. We should note exception window for Dedicated cutover.

josh: Monitoring: add these dashboards — request rate, tail latency (p95/p99), model fallback rate, kv-cache hit rate, oom count. Alert on p99>400ms for >5m and fallback rate >1%.

anika: Docs item: include small troubleshooting snippet:
```
# if fallback triggered
curl -X POST ... -H 'x-redwood-version: v2'
# check model_fallback_count in metrics
```

tom: Support playbook: add canned customer responses for SLA read requests and guidance for cost spikes. I'll coordinate with CS.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: private-package v1 -> staging at 1777772050, prod cutover tentative 1777772100 :robot_face:

maria: Pricing: finops needs a freeze on list prices for launch; we can allow promotional credits. Who owns final pricing doc?

josh: I'll sync with finops + product to lock pricing knobs. Need to confirm unit definitions (token vs embed).

anika: Risk: customer-driven features (custom KMS) are not in scope for GA. Will call out in docs and commercial term. @maria OK?

maria: Yes, call out as 'GA scope excludes custom KMS & on-prem air-gapped packaging' — roadmap item for post-GA.

tom: Action items summary:
- SLA doc owner: josh
- Customer runbook & API examples: anika
- Oncall/playbook: tom
- Monitoring + alerts: josh
- Pricing lock: josh + maria + finops
- Launch communications: maria

maria: Please add owners to the launch checklist in the doc and mark blockers. Fast follow items get a separate 'post-GA' bucket. :white_check_mark:
